YOUTUBE PLAYABLE TEMPLATE, COMMON RULES. First script in index.html: <script src="https://www.youtube.com/game_api/v1"></script>. Wrap ytgame in a platform module with stubs so it runs without the SDK: firstFrameReady after first frame, gameReady once when Title accepts input, sendScore({value:int}) on Result, loadData/saveData JSON {"v":1,"best":0,"runs":0,"progress":{}}, onPause = freeze + silence + save, onResume = stay Paused, isAudioEnabled/onAudioEnabledChange drive master gain (no mute button), errors -> health.logError. No network, fonts, images, audio files, localStorage. All values in game_spec.json (stage units, seconds, palette tokens). Canvas fills window, stage 720x1280 fit contain, DPR cap 2, works 9:32 to 32:9, HUD anchored to screen edges + safe area: score top-left, timer top-center, pause top-right. Fixed 1/60 step, pools, no allocation in loop. States BOOT, TITLE, PLAY, PAUSED, RESULT. Input = actions from keys AND Pointer Events (tap, hold, swipe, drag, zones, joystick), same actions on keyboard and touch, buttons reachable by Enter/Space and Escape/P, touch-action none. Flat primitives, palette bg #121318 surface #1E2028 line #343846 text #F4F5F7 player #4CC9F0 hazard #F25F5C pickup #FFD166 positive #06D6A0 special #B388FF neutral #7D8597, system-ui font. Synth Web Audio sfx: uiTap start collect hit destroy action powerup win lose. Modules: spec platform viewport input audio save pool draw ui game world systems skins (skins read only look).

GAME: NARRATIVE SIMULATION. Stage 720x1280 fit contain, UI only. You lead a settlement: each day a card brings a request with two choices that move four stats. Put these sections in game_spec.json:
{"meta":{"id":"narrative-sim","title":"The Settlement","version":"0.1.0","archetype":"narrative-sim","scoreLabel":"Days"},"input":{"bindings":{"chooseLeft":{"keys":["ArrowLeft","KeyA","Digit1"],"pointer":"leftButton"},"chooseRight":{"keys":["ArrowRight","KeyD","Digit2"],"pointer":"rightButton"},"drag":{"keys":[],"pointer":"cardDrag"},"confirm":{"keys":["Enter","Space"],"pointer":"tap"}}},"rules":{"targetTurns":40,"twoStepChoice":true,"swipeThreshold":140,"previewMode":"dots","bigChangeThreshold":15,"noRepeatWindow":5,"storylineWeight":2,"fallbackEventId":"quietDay","winEndingId":"foundersDay","transitionDuration":0.25,"statTweenDuration":0.4},"card":{"width":560,"height":680,"y":660,"tilt":12,"avatarSize":120,"textMaxLines":6,"look":{"shape":"roundRect","color":"surface","w":560,"h":680}},"stats":[{"id":"food","label":"Food","min":0,"max":100,"start":50,"fatalAtMax":true,"endingAtMin":"emptyGranary","endingAtMax":"rottingStores","look":{"shape":"circle","color":"pickup","size":44}},{"id":"mood","label":"Mood","min":0,"max":100,"start":50,"fatalAtMax":true,"endingAtMin":"silentSquare","endingAtMax":"endlessFestival","look":{"shape":"diamond","color":"positive","size":44}},{"id":"coins","label":"Coins","min":0,"max":100,"start":50,"fatalAtMax":true,"endingAtMin":"emptyChest","endingAtMax":"gildedCage","look":{"shape":"hexagon","color":"special","size":44}},{"id":"safety","label":"Safety","min":0,"max":100,"start":50,"fatalAtMax":true,"endingAtMin":"openGates","endingAtMax":"ironRule","look":{"shape":"triangle","color":"player","size":44}}]}

LAYOUT
Stat icons (look) with vertical bars in a row at y 200 under the HUD. Card (card.look, card.width x card.height) centered at x 360, y card.y: avatar shape at the top, character name, event text wrapped once per card (max card.textMaxLines; if longer, step the font down 4 u, min 24). Two choice buttons at y 1130 (300x100 each) with the choice labels.

CHOICE (same on every input)
lean = none/left/right. chooseLeft/chooseRight: if rules.twoStepChoice and not already leaning that side, only lean; otherwise choose that side. confirm (Enter/Space or tap on the card) chooses the leaned side. Leaning moves the card 40 u to that side, rotates it card.tilt/2, highlights the label and button, and shows the preview.
cardDrag: card x = 360 + dx, rotation = card.tilt * clamp(dx/swipeThreshold, -1, 1); |dx| > 20 shows that side's lean; release with |dx| >= swipeThreshold chooses, else springs back in 0.15 s. Ignore input during card transitions (rules.transitionDuration).
PREVIEW by rules.previewMode: "dots" = a dot above each stat the leaned choice changes, small if |delta| < bigChangeThreshold else big, never the direction; "full" = + or - signs; "none" = nothing.

EFFECTS
On a choice: card flies off to that side, then for each effects[statId] = d: value = clamp(value + round(d * scale), min, max) with scale 1 for now; bars tween over rules.statTweenDuration. Then turn += 1. Fatal check: first stat in order with value <= min ends the run with its endingAtMin; else first with fatalAtMax and value >= max ends with its endingAtMax. If turn >= rules.targetTurns, the run ends with rules.winEndingId. For now show the ending id on RESULT.
Until the next prompt, repeat this test event: {"who":"farmer","text":"The harvest came early. Sell some?","left":{"label":"Keep it","effects":{"food":10,"coins":-5}},"right":{"label":"Sell it","effects":{"food":-10,"coins":15}}}.

SCORE
Score = turns survived (the ending choice included). On RESULT: sendScore(turn).

Systems on each choice, in order: choice, effects, turn, ending, next card. Per frame only drag, springs, tweens and transitions. Skins: drawCard, drawAvatar, drawStatIcon reading only look. Check: a run with keyboard only, taps only, drags only.
